nodes.name: description_label
nodes.text:
Projects a solid, indestructible energy wall in a straight line from the front of the machine. The base field is 3 blocks long and 3 blocks high. Entities touching or standing very close to the projected wall take contact damage. The barrier never replaces existing blocks, so obstructed cells remain empty and are reported on the status screen.

The left Size Upgrade slot increases length and the middle Size Upgrade slot increases height, up to eight levels each. The Energy Upgrade slot reduces upkeep. Use the power button to enable or disable the projection. The field shuts down automatically when energy is insufficient.
